source: fantasy-model/export_site_payload.py — a 1-point-PPR projection model over nflverse player-week data, copied rather than recomputed
note: Every figure arrives settled from the model repo. The site computes nothing here (§11). Boards are capped at the model's own limit; the full tables live in that repo as CSV.

scoring.kicking: 1 per extra point; 3 for a field goal inside 40, 4 from 40-49, 5 from 50+
scoring.defense: 1 per sack, 2 per takeaway, 2 per safety, 6 per touchdown, plus a points-allowed tier

QB.kind: permutation importance, in points of error

K.kind: permutation importance, in points of error

board_rule.reason: A player needs a full season of NFL history — 16 games — to be recommended on this board. A projection built on fewer rests on too little to rank: at kicker, where the model's draft-day rank correlation is near zero and its projections span a fraction of the real range, two career games was enough to top the board on noise alone. The rule costs real second-year players at the skill positions, and every one it removes is listed here. The projections themselves are unchanged and still carry every player.
